label: MiniMax — Video

must: Everything goes into main_prompt as one continuous block: the action, the camera path, the sound and any dialogue. There are no separate motion, audio or camera fields - the user pastes main_prompt into a single field in the generator.
Short and concrete. MiniMax degrades with long prompts.
One subject action, one camera move, one lighting statement.
avoid: Scene cuts, unless the user's briefing defines them.
Section labels or field names inside the prompt.

notes_for_model: Keep it under roughly eighty words in the balanced density. Extra detail costs coherence here.
